g.text: How should other people's guesses be displayed?
216 people answered 42 questions in 18 groups of 12. All panels average over the same 42 questions.
Dashed lines: initial private estimates. Solid lines: revised estimates after the named information display.
Jayles, Sire & Kurvers (2021) | doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2021.0231 | Data: figshare 12529571
Panel estimate = geometric mean. Each display has 6 independent groups; intervals resample whole groups.
Curves average over 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 or 11 shared peer estimates. The next page separates that experimental factor.
Every facet uses its own initial reference. Dashed = before feedback; solid = after revision.
k counts reports sampled from existing groups. It is not the number of participants needed to run the social experiment.
